summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnishing the notice and proxy statement for an annual general meeting. The proposals include re-election of directors, reappointment of auditor, and a share consolidation authorizing a reverse stock split of 1-for-2 to 1-for-100 at the board's discretion — a standard measure to regain Nasdaq compliance. No special situation (merger, tender, activist, spinoff, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst) is present. This filing is purely an ordinary meeting notice with a typical reverse-split authorization, not a standalone corporate change event.
